Based on my research, I have found clear evidence regarding the superintendent of Sterling School District, Connecticut for the 2025–2026 school year.

**Theodore Friend** is the superintendent of Sterling School District, Connecticut for the 2025–2026 school year [2][6]. He is explicitly identified as superintendent with an active email address (tfriend@sterlingschool.org) and phone extension in the district's contact information [6]. A superintendent contract document shows his contract runs from July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2027 [1], confirming his status for the current school year. This is further corroborated by a Board of Education meeting document dated March 20, 2024, which lists Theodore Friend as superintendent, and a more recent document dated September 16, 2025, reference to his 2025–2026 school year goals .

============================================================
**Oneida Township S/D #3 (Strange School Elementary), a single-school district in Grand Ledge, MI (NCES LEAID 2626430), does not list a superintendent on available sources. For 2025–2026, the top leader is likely the principal, but no name is identified for that role on staff or district pages.**

## District Overview
This is a small, independent regular public school district (not part of a supervisory union) with one elementary school at 8981 Oneida Road, Grand Ledge, MI. It operates as a one-room schoolhouse established in 1879, following Grand Ledge Public Schools for closings/delays, under Eaton RESA. With only ~28 students (all schools-of-choice), it has a 3-member school board but no named administrative leader beyond board members like Vincent Toman (President), Cindy Coakley, and Rachael Brunger.[2]

## Leadership Search Findings
No superintendent or principal name appears on the district's apparent sites (eatonresa.org/our-districts/strange-school-elementary/ or strangeschool.org), staff directories, or recent news for 2025–2026. Eaton RESA's superintendent (Dr. Sean Williams) oversees the RESA, not this district directly. Teachers like Mrs. Reed are listed, but no top administrator.[3][5]

This small district (2 schools, ~213 students) operates as Moffat Consolidated School District #2, also referenced as Moffat School District No. 2 in the county of Saguache. [3]

The official district website lists Ande Davis as Superintendent in the administration section, with contact adavis@moffatschools.org, alongside other staff like Principal Kathy Garcia. The Colorado Department of Education's SchoolView profile confirms "Superintendent: Andrea Davis," and the site features "Moffat Minute" updates by Superintendent Ms. Davis, indicating active leadership as of February 2026. A 2025 Rural Superintendent Academy listed her as "Incoming Superintendent," with a April-May 2025 superintendent search (job posting and interviews) confirming her hire for 2025-26 after prior interim leadership ended. No conflicting current names found; older news (pre-2025) references prior superintendents like Kirk Banghart. [1][3][3][5][1][7][4]

LEAID=0506630 | GLEN ROSE SCHOOL DISTRICT, ARKANSAS | Targeted Retry
============================================================
The evidence now shows a clear superintendent transition. **Chad Jordan is the current superintendent of Glen Rose School District as of February 27, 2026.** The most recent and authoritative sources confirm this:

- **District website (current):** The official staff directory  and staff profile page  list Chad Jordan as Superintendent, with the staff directory dated 2022-03-04 but presumed current as a live district website page.
- **Current school year news:** A September 25, 2025 district news post  references "Superintendent Mr. Chad Jordan" welcoming staff to the school year, and a September 24, 2025 event announcement  invites the community to "Meet the Superintendent" and learn about the "new Superintendent."
- **Prior superintendent:** Timothy W. Holicer held the position through at least the 2024–25 school year [10] but has transitioned out. The 2025 accreditation report (ADE data center) [10] is dated from the previous school year (2024–25) and still lists Holicer, confirming he was superintendent until the 2024–25 year ended.

Chad Jordan began his role before the 2025–26 school year, so he is the current serving superintendent with no pending future start date. A transition did occur during the 2025–26 school year period (specifically over summer 2025, between school years).

LEAID=2312140 | Sedgwick Public Schools, MAINE | Targeted Retry
============================================================
Based on my research, I can now provide a clarified answer. Sedgwick Public Schools is governed by **School Union 76**, not as an independent district superintendent. The superintendent serves the entire union and is the top leader above the school principal.

## Governance Structure

Sedgwick Elementary School is one school within School Union 76, which serves four towns: Sedgwick, Brooklin, Deer Isle, and Stonington. [5] The superintendent of School Union 76 is the district administrator with authority over all schools in the union, including Sedgwick Elementary School. [4] Carla Magoon serves as Principal of Sedgwick Elementary School but reports to the superintendent. [1][5]

## Current Superintendent Status

Mark Hurvitt is currently serving as Superintendent of School Union 76, listed on the official SU 76 administration webpage. [1] However, this follows significant leadership disruption: Daniel Ross was placed on administrative leave in December 2024 after a unanimous vote by the school board, following a vote of no confidence from educators. [8] Tara McKechnie was hired as the next superintendent in April 2025, [1] but her start date has not yet arrived as of February 2026, so Mark Hurvitt continues serving in the interim superintendent role.

I've identified a critical distinction: there are **two different Pioneer Union Elementary districts** in California with the same name structure but different locations and governance:

1. **Pioneer Union Elementary** (Berry Creek, Butte County, NCES LEAID 0630520) — your query
2. **Pioneer Union Elementary School District** (Kings County/Kern County area, NCES LEAID 0630510) — different district

For **Pioneer Union Elementary (Berry Creek, CA)** — the district matching your NCES LEAID 0630520:

The California Department of Education directory (updated July 14, 2025) clearly lists [1] **Darcy Pollak as Superintendent**. [5] The district's own School Board page (dated Dec 31, 2024) confirms "Darcy Pollak- Superintendent Board Secretary."  The district staff directory lists "Pollak, Darcy. Superintendent."  The district's Contact Us page identifies "Darcy Pollak - Superintendent/Principal."

Darcy Pollak holds the dual title of **Superintendent/Principal** — a common structure in single-school districts — and is the correct superintendent to report.

LEAID=4703090 | Morgan County, TENNESSEE | Step 1
============================================================
Based on my research, I found two different school systems called "Morgan County Schools." The correct district for Wartburg, TN is **Morgan County School District** in Tennessee, which uses the website `mcsed.net`. This is the district specified in the NCES LEAID 4703090.

According to the Tennessee state education database and the district's official website, there is a discrepancy in the current superintendent information. The state records (as of early 2026) list **Jamie Pemberton** as the "Superintendent" [5]. However, the more recent district website at morgank12.org (updated 2024–2025) identifies **Tracie Turrentine** as the "Superintendent of Morgan County Schools" [1].

The search results show that the district website mcsed.net lists **Jamie Pemberton** as "Director of Schools" [2], which is Tennessee's terminology for the chief district administrator, equivalent to superintendent in other states. Tennessee law uses the title "Director of Schools" rather than "Superintendent" for regular public school districts.

Since Tracie Turrentine's superintendent page on morgank12.org is from the 2024–2025 school year and remains current on the district's website (with no departure news), she appears to be the superintendent for 2025–2026. However, there is a discrepancy worth noting: one state record lists Pemberton, while the more prominent district website lists Turrentine.

LEAID=4017700 | LIBERTY, OKLAHOMA | Retry
============================================================
Based on my research, I cannot identify a current superintendent for Liberty Public Schools (Sequoyah County, Oklahoma, NCES LEAID 4017700) as of February 2026. Here's what I found:

**Critical findings:**

- **Chris Michael's departure confirmed:** The November 2025 news article documents that Chris Michael, who had served 15 years as superintendent, announced his departure at the end of November 2025 to join the Oklahoma State Department of Education [1].

- **No successor identified in current sources:** Multiple searches of the district website (liberty.seq.k12.ok.us), state education records, and news sources from November 2025 through February 2026 failed to identify an interim superintendent, acting superintendent, or new superintendent who has assumed the role since Michael's departure three months ago.

- **District website inaccessible for personnel info:** The district website provides only basic contact information (address and phone) with no staff directory or administration page listing a superintendent.

- **Possible confusion with other districts:** My searches surfaced Liberty Public Schools in Missouri (lps53.org) and Liberty County schools in Georgia, but not clear current leadership information for the Oklahoma Liberty Public Schools (seq.k12.ok.us).

The most recent search result snippet (web:14) from the superintendent search page states that "Mr. Alfonso Llano, will resign from our school district on February 27, 2026," but the full page content was not accessible to determine the current acting leadership.

Without confirmation of an acting superintendent or interim leader in the current school year (2025–26), and given that Llano's departure is effective as of today, the district may currently be in a transition period.
